prompt: Hand-drawn storyboard sheet, quick pencil sketch on white paper, confident graphite lines, light grey wash shading, one soft muted blue accent only on the sweater. Exactly three equal rectangular panels side by side in one horizontal row, each panel with a thin black frame, separated by equal white gutters. The same character in all three panels: a 16-year-old Chilean high-school boy with short dark wavy hair, wearing a plain navy blue V-neck sweater over a white shirt collar, with no patches or badges. Left panel, wide shot: the whole small bedroom is visible, the boy sits on the edge of his bed, just woken up, stretching one arm to switch off a round alarm clock on the bedside table, a window with soft morning light, a backpack on the floor. Middle panel, medium shot from the waist up: the same boy at a small kitchen table, in a hurry, a bread roll in one hand and a mug in the other, face visible, looking sideways. Right panel, extreme close-up: only the boy's two hands pulling the zipper of a dark backpack closed, the hands filling the panel. No text, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no captions.
